column1: # exclusions.tsv -- every form of the vendored R7RS suite that Emit does not run,
# or runs and gets wrong.  Both are "the suite cannot use this form yet": treating them
# alike is what lets this file be the single gate, instead of leaving the suite
# permanently red for every known defect.
# NOT generated: hand-maintained, and checked in BOTH directions by
# test/r7rs-suite-tests.sh -- a form that regresses fails the suite, and so does a form
# that is excluded but has started passing (a stale exclusion).  Closing a conformance
# gap is therefore expected to fail this suite once, naming the forms to un-exclude.
#   deliberate:<ref>  Emit will never support it; <ref> decided so
#   unimplemented     a known gap with no issue yet
#   blocked-by:<key>  excluded only because the form it depends on is excluded
# Draft a replacement with: test/r7rs-suite-tests.sh --discover   (then retag -- raw
